page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page shows only fragmentary margin text at the left edge (partly cut off, not transcribed as readable notes); right page has one text column of running text with a running head "PARTITIONES" and page number "3" at top right, and a signature "b 2" at the foot of the text column.

main_text.p: Personae huiusce dialogi sunt, Pater & Filius. Filio partes interrogandi dantur, patri respondendi. & quoniam in Dialogis decorum maximè spectatur, idcirco filio attribuitur reuerentia: patri verò authoritas docendi. nam decorum illud potissimum in personis uerfatur, in quibus aetas, sexus, genus, patria, uita, institutum, natura, mores, consideranturEt quoniam dialogi, omne dicendi genus admittunt, summum & medium & infimum: in hoc Partitionum dialogo, subtile tenuéq; illud dicendi genus elucet, cuiusmodi esse debet in hac ratione docendi: in qua omnia tenuiter & subtiliter, tum exquiruntur, tum etiam distribuuntur. Atq; haec de scribendi genere.

Nunc pauca de totius operis summa distributione dicenda sunt. Totum harum Partitionum opus tres habet primas partes: principium, oratoriarum partitionum explicationem, & totius operis conclusionem. Principium duobus capitibus continetur, petitione & concessione. Expositio praeceptorum tribus: officio oratoris, oratione, quaestione: quas partes secuti, tres fecimus Explicationum libros: quarum rursum multae & variae sunt partes. Superest Conclusio, cuius capita & membra suo indicabimus loco.

page.notes: Left page margin fragments are cut off at the scan edge and too incomplete to transcribe reliably. Running head and page number are as printed at the top of the right page. The printed line "PARTI-" at the foot is a catchword-like hyphenated word continuing onto the next page.
